h: Old prayer by VeryDarkMan's mother for Davido resurfaces amid their feud
p: An older prayer said by VeryDarkMan's mother for Davido has resurfaced online as the two continue to trade words. Cubana Chiefpriest also made a subtle remark about Davido.
more: Fans of both sides have been commenting heavily.
Neither camp has ended the back-and-forth.
